opportunities.title: Building Plan Redesign for Permit
opportunities.description: I have an existing architectural drawing that now needs to be taken from concept stage to something a contractor and the local permitting office can work with. The layout itself is basically set, but line weights, dimensions, symbols, notes, and overall presentation must meet standard construction-document conventions. You will start from my current file (PDF and DWG are available) and: • Clean up every layer so walls, doors, windows, structural elements, and annotations follow a consistent naming and color system. • Add any missing dimensions, room tags, section marks, north arrow, scale bar, and legend so the plans are self-explanatory. • Produce coordinated floor plan, roof plan, and two key elevations—ready to be stamped once the engineer reviews them. • Deliver a final DWG (AutoCAD 2018 or newer) plus a print-ready PDF set at 1:100. Local code notes and title-block standards will be provided the moment we start; I simply need your drafting expertise to translate what I have into permit-ready sheets fast and accurately.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40801602, publicado hace 3 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 250 - 750.

opportunities.title: Diseño y Creación de Catálogo de Navidad Interactivo para Lalicorer...
opportunities.description: Se busca un diseñador editorial proactivo y con experiencia para crear un catálogo de Navidad interactivo para lalicorera.com. El proyecto incluye el diseño de la portada, contraportada, reverso y aproximadamente 56 páginas internas. El contenido del catálogo relacionará productos de nuestra web, incluyendo anchetas y otros artículos. Un requisito clave es que el catálogo sea interactivo, permitiendo a los usuarios hacer clic en los productos para ser dirigidos directamente a la página correspondiente en la web. Se proporcionará un archivo Excel con las URLs de cada producto para facilitar la integración. Los entregables esperados son el catálogo montado en una plataforma de publicación digital como Issuu, un archivo PDF del catálogo completo y los archivos editables del diseño. opportunities.title: Desarrollador Web Experto en Wordpress y Wix para Nuevo Sitio Insti...
opportunities.description: Buscamos desarrollador web con experiencia avanzada y comprobable en wordpress y wix para desarrollar desde cero una nueva página web institucional de una organización ubicada en estados unidos. Actualmente, la organización cuenta con una página web desarrollada en Wix, pero nuestro objetivo es crear un sitio completamente nuevo, con diseño moderno, profesional, funcional y preparado para el crecimiento futuro. Queremos desarrollar una nueva web, ya sea en Wix o WordPress, dependiendo de cuál plataforma resulte más conveniente. Requisitos indispensables: Dominio avanzado y comprobable de WordPress y Wix. Experiencia sólida desarrollando páginas web desde cero en ambas plataformas. Portafolio de proyectos reales, profesionales y verificables. Experiencia en diseño ux/ui y desarrollo responsive. Conocimientos de SEO, optimización de velocidad y seguridad. Capacidad para integrar formularios, herramientas externas y automatizaciones. Criterio técnico para comparar ambas plataformas y recomendar la más adecuada. Excelente comunicación, responsabilidad y cumplimiento de plazos. Alcance del proyecto: Evaluar las ventajas y limitaciones de Wix y WordPress para este proyecto. Recomendar la plataforma más conveniente y justificar técnicamente la decisión. Proponer una estructura y diseño completamente renovados. Desarrollar la nueva página web desde cero. Para postularse es obligatorio: Compartir al menos 3 proyectos web profesionales desarrollados. Mostrar ejemplos reales de trabajos realizados en Wix y WordPress. Explicar brevemente qué criterios utiliza para recomendar una plataforma sobre otra. Disponibilidad para reuniones virtuales y tiempo estimado de ejecución. Buscamos un profesional freelance ubicado en Latinoamérica, con quien podamos establecer una relación de colaboración a largo plazo. Abstenerse desarrolladores que únicamente adapten plantillas básicas. Valoramos experiencia demostrable, calidad de diseño, criterio técnico y compromiso profesional. Categoría: Programación y Tecnología Subcategoría: Programación Web ¿Cuál es el alcance del proyecto?: Crear un nuevo sitio personalizado

opportunities.title: Audio AI Labeling Workflow Guidance
opportunities.description: I’m setting up a full-cycle workflow for labeling audio data that will later feed our AI models. The recordings include calls and free-form speech, and every file must end up with: • A word-level transcript • Accurate speaker diarization (who spoke and when) • Tags for sentiment, topics, and other key events I already have the raw audio and a basic storage setup; what I need now is your guidance on the most efficient, scalable way to handle annotation, quality control, and hand-off to model training. That covers tool selection (Label Studio, PyTorch, Whisper, pyannote, or similar), process design, automation scripts, and clear documentation so my in-house team can keep the pipeline running after you’re done. Please be comfortable working with large audio datasets, ASR, speaker diarization, and sentiment/topic classification, and be able to share concrete examples of past labeling pipelines you’ve built. I’m based in South-East Asia and would like to collaborate closely, so overlapping hours with India, Pakistan, Europe, or the wider Asian region will be ideal. Deliverables • A written workflow/architecture plan • Setup scripts or notebooks for the chosen labeling platform • QA checklist and sampling strategy for label validation • Handoff guide so my team can maintain and extend the process independently If you can help me turn a pile of raw audio into clean, richly labeled data ready for model training, let’s talk.

opportunities.title: Original Classical Music Composition Needed
opportunities.description: I’m preparing a project that calls for an entirely new classical work, fully notated and ready for rehearsal. The score should be written in standard orchestral notation, formatted cleanly in Sibelius, Finale, or MuseScore so that individual parts can be extracted without extra clean-up. A master PDF score and separate part PDFs will be the final physical deliverables, alongside an editable source file and a MusicXML export to guarantee future flexibility. Here’s what I expect at hand-off: • A complete, original classical composition (duration and instrumentation discussed once we connect) • Professionally engraved full score in PDF • Individual part PDFs, correctly paginated and titled • Source notation file (Sibelius .sib, Finale .musx, or MuseScore .mscz) • MusicXML version for archive and DAW import • A quick stereo reference render—MIDI or sample library—so I can review balance before printing All melodic, harmonic, and rhythmic content must be your own work; no public-domain rearrangements. Should you prefer to collaborate on thematic material, I can supply sketches, but the primary creative direction will be yours. I aim for clarity and accuracy over speed, though a realistic timeline is important. After delivering a first draft, I’ll give written feedback; one revision round should handle any notation tweaks or orchestration touches that arise. If this scope aligns with your skill set, we’ll move forward by confirming instrumentation, length, and delivery milestones.

opportunities.title: Life-Size Silicone Phenacodus Model
opportunities.description: I want a one-of-a-kind, life-size Phenacodus that looks and feels alive in my hands. The project has two equally important parts: first, a watertight, high-resolution 3D model suitable for immediate SLA/FDM printing; second, the finished silicone figure shipped to me, fully bendable from nose to tail without visible joints. Look & accuracy I have a very specific vision that blends scientific accuracy with personal aesthetic choices. Once we start, I’ll share sketches and notes so you can sculpt the exact proportions, pose range, and skin texture I’m picturing. The animal is hairless, so subtle wrinkling and muscle definition need to read well in both the digital sculpt and the final cast. Flexibility & construction • Full-body articulation: an internal wire or poseable spine/limb armature that allows smooth, repeated bends while holding poses. • Silicone skin: soft-touch platinum silicone (Shore 00-20-30 range) poured or roto-cast in a single seamless piece. No rigid inserts should telegraph through the surface. • Paint finish: intrinsic tinting preferred so color is inside the silicone, with minimal external sealing. Deliverables 1. Printable 3D files (STL/OBJ) + a low-poly preview. 2. A short print/casting workflow document noting material volumes and any mold parting strategy. 3. The completed, life-size silicone Phenacodus shipped safely to my address. Acceptance criteria • Model matches my reference feedback to within ±2 mm on key measurements. • Finished toy can flex 90° at neck and tail, 45° at each limb joint, and return to neutral without tearing. • Surface is smooth, free of air bubbles, and color-matched to agreed palette. Experience with ZBrush/Blender for organic sculpting, knowledge of mold-making, and hands-on silicone casting will be key. Let me know your proposed timeline from sculpt to shipping and any questions you have about the pose range or material specs.

opportunities.title: Claude Agents (Builders, thinker, reviewer)
opportunities.description: I want a custom Claude agent that turns my written briefs into fully-formed PowerPoint decks without me lifting a finger. The workflow is straightforward: I paste an outline, the agent taps into my existing slide library as a style guide, then chooses matching layouts—or engineers new ones when the brief demands—before exporting a polished .pptx. Visual consistency is critical, yet I still expect creative flexibility when the topic outgrows the current library. The finished slides must feel as if a senior consultant assembled them: crisp hierarchy, clean data visuals, professional animation choices, and strict adherence to brand colors and typography. I’m happy to grant API keys, sample decks, and the library itself. Code can live in Python or any stack you prefer, provided it calls the Claude API efficiently, handles prompt engineering, and leaves room for future extensions (e.g., automated document review or multi-step workflows). Deliverables • Well-documented codebase and prompts that build the deck end-to-end • One-click deployment instructions (local or cloud) • A demo video or walkthrough proving the agent converts a sample brief into a ready-to-present file Acceptance will be based on slide fidelity to the style guide, error-free automation, and clear documentation that lets me extend the agent later for other tasks such as review cycles. additionally i want another agent to be the agent who decides what he writes on each slide and think as a consultant when building decks, finally i want a reviewer agent who reviews everything before being submitted to me.

opportunities.title: Ilustrador/a Infantil Estilo con personalidad
opportunities.description: Estoy terminando mi primer cuento infantil ilustrado y necesito un/a ilustrador/a que, al igual que yo, esté dando sus primeros pasos y quiera crecer con este proyecto. El libro consta de 36 páginas ya maquetadas; sé exactamente qué sucede en cada escena y tengo ideas claras de la composición y el texto definitivo. Lo que busco • Un estilo suave y tierno, tipo acuarela o otros estilos con texturas que transmita calidez y humor a la vez. • Comunicación fluida: quiero comentar referencias, recibir avances y pulir detalles juntos. • Compromiso con plazos realistas; cosas claras. Entregables necesarios - 36 ilustraciones interiores ajustadas a mis indicaciones. - Diseño de la portada que mantenga la misma línea gráfica. - Archivos listos para imprimir: PDF a color CMYK 300 dpi, con sangrados y márgenes seguros. Cómo presentar tu propuesta 1. Envíame un enlace a tu portafolio o redes donde pueda ver trabajos similares. 2. Incluye un presupuesto claro que contemple: • Ilustraciones interiores • Portada • Preparación de los archivos finales para imprenta 3. Si lo deseas, añade una breve descripción de tu proceso de trabajo o cualquier valor añadido que ofrezcas (no es imprescindible.). Quiero dar oportunidad a gente que, como yo, está empezando a construir su camino, así que la pasión y la ilusión por el proyecto serán lo que más pese. ¡Espero ver tu arte y poder crear algo mágico juntos!

opportunities.title: Existing House Layout Redesign
opportunities.description: I have the original drawings for my house and now need a fresh set that reflects a complete redesign of the room layout and internal walls. The structure’s footprint stays the same, but I want the flow between spaces re-imagined, creating a more logical, airy arrangement throughout. You will start from my current plans (PDF and DWG files) and produce updated floor plans, any required elevations, and wall removal/addition notes. Accuracy is key: dimensions must align with the existing structural grid so my builder can use them without extra redlining. Please work in AutoCAD, Revit, or another mainstream drafting tool you are comfortable exporting to DWG and PDF. I’ll provide feedback in two revision rounds; after final approval I need both editable source files and print-ready PDFs.

opportunities.title: Build Affordable Multi-Tenant SaaS CRM
opportunities.description: I want to develop an affordable, modern, responsive web-based SaaS CRM software for small businesses, agencies, real estate agents, coaching institutes and service providers. **Main Goal:** Build a simple CRM platform that helps businesses manage customer leads, track sales and automate follow-up workflows. **Required Features (MVP):** 1. User registration, login and secure authentication. 2. Modern dashboard with leads, customers and sales statistics. 3. Lead management (add, edit, delete and organize leads). 4. Lead status tracking (New, Contacted, Interested, Converted, Lost). 5. Follow-up reminders and task management. 6. WhatsApp click-to-chat integration with customizable message templates. 7. Customer notes and activity history. 8. Search, filters and CSV export. 9. Responsive design for desktop, tablet and mobile. 10. Multi-user and multi-business support with secure data separation. **Technical Requirements:** - Build using a scalable and maintainable technology stack. - Use affordable hosting and database solutions. - Avoid unnecessary paid APIs and expensive third-party services. - Keep the architecture ready for future subscription plans and payment gateway integration. **Deliverables:** - Fully functional web application. - Complete source code. - Database and backend setup. - Deployment assistance. - Basic documentation. - Ownership of the source code and intellectual property. **Important:** I am looking for an experienced freelancer who can suggest the most cost-effective development approach. Please provide: 1. Your fixed-price quotation. 2. Estimated development timeline. 3. Recommended technology stack. 4. Previous SaaS or CRM projects you have developed. 5. Post-launch bug support. My priority is a reliable MVP with clean code, good user experience and low development and maintenance costs. I want to develop this product commercially and sell subscriptions to customers.

opportunities.title: Turkish Design Sofa Manufacturer Research (import - export)
opportunities.description: Turkish Furniture Sourcing Researcher — Manufacturer Identification I’m developing Home Glance, a UK-based furniture brand specialising in distinctive, artistic and beautifully designed sofas. I’m looking for an experienced Turkish-speaking researcher or furniture sourcing specialist to identify reliable Turkish manufacturers whose collections align with our brand’s design direction. What We’re Looking For Our focus is on unique, artistic, design-led and visually striking sofas that stand apart from conventional contemporary furniture. We’re particularly interested in manufacturers offering original, elegant, sculptural or architecturally distinctive designs, combining exceptional aesthetics with high-quality craftsmanship and competitive wholesale pricing. I will provide reference images to illustrate the specific aesthetic and design direction we’re looking for. These references are intended as inspiration rather than exact products that must be found. We’re interested in discovering manufacturers with similarly distinctive and creative collections. Your Responsibilities * Research Turkish sofa manufacturers, particularly those based in established furniture manufacturing regions such as İnegöl, Kayseri and Istanbul. * Identify manufacturers whose sofa designs closely align with the provided visual references. * Locate official company websites, product catalogues and photographs of relevant designs. * Find publicly available business WhatsApp numbers and email addresses. * Determine whether each company manufactures its own furniture or operates as an intermediary, where verifiable. * Identify evidence of international export capabilities, preferably including experience exporting to the UK. * Gather available information about manufacturing quality, materials, craftsmanship and relevant certifications. Required Deliverables Please provide an organised Excel or Google Sheets spreadsheet containing: 1. Manufacturer name and location. 2. Official website. 3. Direct catalogue or product collection links. 4. Links to representative sofa designs matching the provided references. 5. Publicly available business WhatsApp number and email address. 6. Manufacturer or intermediary status, with supporting evidence where available. 7. Evidence of export capabilities and available quality information. 8. A brief explanation of why each manufacturer is suitable for Home Glance. Quality and relevance are considerably more important than quantity. We’re looking for approximately 10–20 carefully researched manufacturers, not hundreds of generic furniture suppliers. Ideal Candidate * Fluent in Turkish, with good written English. * Experienced in supplier research, sourcing or furniture manufacturing. * Familiar with the Turkish furniture industry. * Comfortable researching Turkish-language websites, catalogues and manufacturer directories. * Able to recognise distinctive designs that match visual references rather than simply collecting generic furniture companies. Project Structure I’d like to begin with a small paid trial identifying five suitable manufacturers. If the research meets our expectations, we’ll proceed with a larger shortlist of approximately 15–20 manufacturers. I will handle contacting manufacturers and discussing potential partnerships myself. This project is specifically focused on identifying and researching suitable suppliers. When Applying Please briefly explain: 1. Your experience researching Turkish furniture manufacturers. 2. Whether you have existing knowledge or contacts within the Turkish furniture industry. 3. How you would identify manufacturers whose products match the reference images. 4. Your proposed fixed price for the initial five-manufacturer trial. Reference images will be provided to shortlisted applicants or attached to this job posting. Thank you. I look forward to finding someone who understands our vision and can help identify suitable long-term manufacturing partners.

opportunities.title: UE5 Fighting Game Character Artist
opportunities.description: **3D Character Modeler & Animator for UE5 Fighting Game — Human-Created Work Only** We’re looking for a skilled 3D character artist and animator to create **two original playable characters** for a stylized 3D action brawler built in Unreal Engine 5. You may apply for modeling, animation, or both. Specialists who can collaborate with other artists and a gameplay programmer are welcome. **Project Scope** The initial goal is two distinctive characters with different fighting styles, strong silhouettes, expressive movement, and impactful combat animations. Work will be divided into agreed milestones. **Character Modeling** - Create two original characters from creative direction and references. - Develop clean, game-ready topology suitable for combat animation. - Produce UVs, textures, and materials. - Prepare models for rigging and integration into UE5. - Balance visual quality with practical game performance. **Rigging and Animation** - Create or work with suitable character rigs; specify whether you provide rigging. - Animate idle stances, walking, running, blocking, dodging, and attacks. - Create combo sequences, launchers, aerial hit reactions, knockdowns, and recoveries. - Use strong poses, anticipation, follow-through, and clear timing to make combat readable and satisfying. - Collaborate with the programmer on animation transitions, attack timing, and UE5 integration. - Where appropriate, create hand-authored smears and impact effects. Please identify any effects that would require a separate VFX artist. The animation should feel fast, forceful, and expressive while supporting responsive gameplay. **Required Experience** - A portfolio of character modeling and/or combat animation you personally created. - Experience preparing characters or animations for Unreal Engine 5. - Proficiency with tools such as Blender, Maya, ZBrush, or Substance 3D. - Understanding of deformation, rigging requirements, and game animation workflows. - Clear communication and reliable progress updates. Experience with fighting games or 3D action brawlers is strongly preferred. **Human-Created Work Only** Generative AI must not be used to create or modify project deliverables, including models, textures, animations, concept art, or effects. Conventional modeling, rigging, procedural tools, and non-generative automation are acceptable. All third-party assets must be disclosed and properly licensed. Applicants must explain their workflow and identify their personal contributions to portfolio examples. **Milestones and Deliverables** We will agree on the animation list, technical specifications, schedule, and pricing before work begins. Please propose a small first milestone that demonstrates your approach to character quality or combat animation. Final deliverables should include editable source files, textures and materials, applicable rigs, UE5-compatible exports, and brief integration notes. **To Apply** Please include: 1. Whether you are applying for modeling, animation, or both. 2. Two or three relevant portfolio examples and your contribution to each. 3. Your experience with UE5 character and animation workflows. 4. Whether you provide rigging and hand-authored combat effects. 5. Your proposed first milestone, estimated timeline, and cost. 6. Your availability and confirmation that you can follow the no-generative-AI requirement.

opportunities.title: Need to Attend an event in Lass Vegas , USA
opportunities.description: I'm looking for a freelancer to attend a conference in Las Vegas, USA, on my behalf. The primary goal of this assignment is to showcase our product. This is a lead generation strategy to bring for future clients. Your responsibilities will include showing the banner to the mass of people present at the event. Who is interested in our product? Just ask to scan the Telegram/WhatsApp/Teams QR given on the banner. Our backend team will be available on those handles, and they will take them forward. The main aim is establishing connections that could lead to future business opportunities. We are looking for a local freelancer in Las Vegas, USA. who can attend a conference on behalf of our company. You have to take snaps during the event. The conference will be for 2 days; just enjoy the time and have fun. The conference is on 26rd & 27th Jan 2027. At the end we want the snap you have taken, and a report on the event should be sent by email. The format of the report will be given by us. A person should be frank enough and have good communication. Key tasks include: - Actively networking with potential clients - Distributing prepared networking materials (business cards and brochures) Ideal skills for this job include: - Strong communication and interpersonal skills - Experience in business networking - Ability to represent a company professionally If you have potential and you are interested, please send me a message so that we can discuss... We can also associate for post-event activity also; if performance is great, we can appoint you as country manager further. Skills Required Sales Marketing Report Writing Lead Generation Business Development Photography

opportunities.title: Fix Mobile App Toolbar Glitch
opportunities.description: Saat aplikasi Android/iPhone saya dibuka pertama kali, bilah menu (toolbar) muncul di posisi yang salah dan menutupi bagian atas konten. Setelah layar bergeser ke halaman lain, masalah biasanya hilang, jadi saya yakin ini berkaitan dengan inisialisasi tampilan awal—mungkin layout constraint, safe-area, atau perhitungan tinggi status bar yang belum selesai saat render pertama. Yang saya butuhkan: • Audit singkat pada kode tampilan awal untuk menemukan penyebab ketidaksinkronan toolbar. • Perbaikan agar toolbar selalu berada di posisi yang benar saat aplikasi pertama kali muncul di semua ukuran layar Android dan iOS. • Build atau APK/IPA uji coba beserta catatan perubahan, agar saya bisa memverifikasi sebelum merge ke branch utama. Saya terbuka pada solusi apa pun—apakah itu penyesuaian XML layout/Storyboard, constraint di Flutter, React Native, atau penanganan programatik saat onCreate/onViewDidLoad—selama hasil akhirnya toolbar tidak lagi menutup konten. Sertakan waktu pengerjaan yang Anda perlukan dan pengalaman relevan Anda saat mengajukan penawaran.

opportunities.title: Comprehensive Home Furniture 3D Design
opportunities.description: I’m developing an entire line of home furniture from scratch and need a skilled designer who can take the project from concept to production-ready files. The scope is broad: every major living room, bedroom, and dining room piece must be conceived, modelled, and presented in high-quality 3D. Here’s what I expect: • Fresh, original concepts for sofas, armchairs, coffee tables, media units, beds, nightstands, wardrobes, dining tables, chairs, and sideboards—nothing is pre-existing. • Editable 3D models (STEP or equivalent) plus fully dimensioned 2D shop drawings that a fabricator can follow without guesswork. • At least three photorealistic renders for each room set so I can market the designs before prototyping. • Thoughtful material and hardware recommendations that balance aesthetics, comfort, and manufacturability. SolidWorks, Rhino, Fusion 360, SketchUp, KeyShot, or a comparable pipeline is fine as long as the final files are clean and accurately scaled. I’ll give prompt feedback on each iteration, and we can move piece by piece or in room-based batches—whichever keeps the workflow smooth. Send over a portfolio that shows comparable residential work and note your typical turnaround time for one complete furniture piece. Let’s create a cohesive, production-ready collection together.

opportunities.title: AI-Generated Amazon Images & EBC
opportunities.description: I’m looking to refresh my Amazon catalogue with polished, AI-generated assets that lift conversion rates and stay 100 % within Amazon’s image and Enhanced Brand Content guidelines. I will supply detailed product specs, feature lists, and a folder of reference images; no physical samples or studio shots are available, so the entire visual set will need to be created digitally. Here is what I need for each SKU: • Clean product photos on a pure-white background (pixel-perfect sizing for main image) • Lifestyle scenes that show realistic use and evoke the product’s target audience • Informative infographics that call out key benefits, specs, and differentiators • A cohesive Enhanced Brand Content (A+ page) layout that weaves these visuals and copy together Please use whatever AI and post-processing tools you’re comfortable with—Midjourney, DALL-E, Stable Diffusion, Photoshop Generative Fill, Canva, etc.—as long as the final files are crisp, royalty-free, and meet Amazon’s technical requirements (minimum 1600 px on the longest side, RGB color space, no watermarks). Acceptance criteria • Visuals render sharp at 200 % zoom with no obvious AI artifacts • Backgrounds isolate the product cleanly; lifestyle composites look natural • Infographics convey information clearly and match the brand palette I provide • EBC upload passes Amazon’s compliance check on the first attempt Please include a link to two or three AI-generated product images you’ve produced for past listings so I can gauge realism and branding cohesion. Once we agree on style, I’ll share the first batch of SKUs and we can set milestones for delivery.

opportunities.title: Robotics Simulation Using NVIDIA Isaac Sim
opportunities.description: We are developing an autonomous robot for light and medium-duty construction (see attached image). We need a simulation of the robot built in NVIDIA Isaac Sim, to test the design and its autonomous behavior before building the next prototype. The robot: a tracked vehicle base; a telescopic mast (about 200 mm in diameter, 1.5 m long) raising a rotating torso with two robotic arms (up to about 10 kg payload); and a camera/sensor head. It works indoors on construction sites — unfinished rooms, door openings, drywall panels and construction materials around, dusty environment. Its job is finishing walls: installing sheetrock (drywall), applying joint compound, sanding, and painting. Work required: 1. Build the robot as an articulated model in NVIDIA Isaac Sim (USD), based on the attached image and the dimensions above: tracked base, telescopic mast, rotating torso, two arms with a gripper and tools. 2. Set up a simple indoor construction-site environment (a room under construction with sheetrock panels, as in the image). 3. Simulate the robot doing its work in sequence: driving into position, installing a sheetrock panel on a wall, applying joint compound to the joints, sanding the joints smooth, and painting the wall — including the mast extending, the torso rotating, and the arms using the automatic tool changer for each task. 4. Add basic sensors (a camera at minimum) and show the robot perceiving its environment. 5. Deliverables: the complete Isaac Sim project files, a short written summary of how the model is set up and how to run it, and a screen-recorded video of the simulation running. Budget: $250–750 USD for this simulation project. Please bid with examples of your NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Omniverse, or robotics simulation work. Note: the attached image is an AI-generated concept render of the robot.

opportunities.title: Editing for Android App
opportunities.description: I need the visual layer of my existing Android application refreshed. The core functionality stays as-is; the task is strictly about restyling and reorganising specific screens—namely the login, profile, and settings views—so they feel cleaner and more in line with modern Material guidelines. You will receive the full Android Studio project and all current assets, so you can work directly in XML layout files, themes, and drawable resources without reverse-engineering an APK. I am open to new colour palettes, typography tweaks, and updated iconography as long as usability is maintained. Deliverables • Updated XML layouts and resource files for the three targeted screens • Any new vector assets, colours, or style definitions bundled into the project • A compiled debug APK so I can quickly test the look and feel • A short change log summarising what you touched Acceptance criteria The redesigned screens must build without errors in Android Studio Iguana, render correctly from API 24 through 34, and keep all existing actions, fields, and validation working exactly as before. That’s the full scope—no backend or feature work required, just a polished, modern user interface on those key screens.

opportunities.title: Google Ads Lead Generation Needed
opportunities.description: I already run Search campaigns for ProFrilo.com and want to hand over full optimisation to someone who knows how to squeeze more high-quality leads out of the same spend. The very first push is on our Packers & Movers service, with a committed ad budget of ₹2,000 per day. What I need you to do • Audit the existing account, refine keyword sets and negative lists, and benchmark against competing movers in Bengaluru. • Re-implement conversion tracking through Google Tag Manager, making sure every call, form fill, and WhatsApp click is captured and attributed. • Tune ad copy, extensions, and responsive assets so they speak directly to relocation customers. • Optimise the current landing pages for speed, trust indicators, and above-the-fold call-to-action placement. • Continue weekly bid, budget, and search-term adjustments, then send me a concise performance report every Friday. Acceptance criteria 1. Cost-per-lead consistently meets or beats the current average within the first month. 2. All conversions (calls, forms, WhatsApp) show in both Google Ads and GA4. 3. Weekly report includes key metrics, optimisation actions taken, and next-week plan. When you reply, include specific examples of Google Ads campaigns you have run for Packers & Movers, along with the results you achieved, your monthly management fee, and how soon you can start.

opportunities.title: Looking for a Python Developer to Build an AI FAQ Assistant
opportunities.description: I need a lightweight FAQ assistant that I can spin up on my own machine and query through a small local web page—nothing cloud-hosted or production-ready yet, just a clean, self-contained prototype. It must be written in Python and powered by the OpenAI API. The assistant should pull its answers from two places only: an editable JSON file that holds the core FAQs and a separate document containing my store policies. If a question falls outside those sources, the bot must openly admit it doesn’t know rather than inventing a response. Accuracy and transparency are crucial. I’m picturing a simple browser interface served locally (Flask or FastAPI are fine). After I launch the script, a page should open where I can type customer-style questions and immediately see the assistant’s replies. Because I’ll be iterating on the content, the JSON and policy file need to be easy to edit and reload without altering the code. Clear, step-by-step setup instructions are expected so I can install dependencies, add my OpenAI key, and run the project on Windows or macOS. Deliverables: • Complete, well-commented Python source code. • Editable FAQ JSON file and policy document template. • Minimal local web front-end served by the script. • README with setup, configuration, and usage directions. • Final package bundled in a ZIP archive. Timeline: 7 days from award. Preferred budget range: $250–$750. In your bid, let me know your technical approach, estimated hours, and any similar work you’ve done with OpenAI integrations or micro chatbots. I’m ready to move quickly on the right proposal.

opportunities.title: Business Case Plataforma Worksite
opportunities.description: Necesito que me ayudes a diseñar y construir el business case que justifique la inversión en una nueva plataforma de soporte para Worksite. El objetivo principal es claro: crear un front de ventas y conciliación de pagos que integre todo el ciclo de pólizas de seguros. Alcance clave • Cotizar, emitir y enviar pólizas al cliente desde un solo punto de venta. • Registrar pagos y conciliarlos automáticamente con cada póliza. • Gestionar renovaciones, cancelaciones y cambios de pólizas sin fricción. Lo que espero recibir 1. Diagnóstico de la situación actual de venta, emisión y recaudación de pólizas en Worksite. 2. Análisis de brechas y oportunidades de mejora en la experiencia de atención al cliente. 3. Propuesta funcional de la plataforma (módulos, flujos y tecnologías sugeridas). 4. Proyección financiera: costos de desarrollo + operación, ahorros estimados y ROI. 5. Hoja de ruta con hitos, tiempos y dependencias. 6. Paquete de presentación listo para directores: documento detallado y resumen ejecutivo en diapositivas. Valoro experiencia previa elaborando business cases para soluciones de seguros o fintech, dominio de métricas de eficiencia operativa y capacidad de traducir requisitos técnicos en argumentos financieros sólidos.

opportunities.title: Steady Income NIFTY Options Algo
opportunities.description: I need a complete, rule-based options strategy for the Indian NIFTY index that targets steady income while keeping risk contained. The approach must be suitable for automation and designed to open, adjust, or close positions on a daily schedule rather than waiting for weekly or monthly expiries, so clear intraday entry and exit logic is essential. The core idea is conservative premium capture: I want the algorithm to favour setups that statistically tilt the odds in my favour without exposing the account to sudden large drawdowns. Spreads, delta-neutral structures, or other limited-risk combinations are all acceptable as long as the overall profile stays aligned with the “steady-income, lower-risk” objective. Please base the strategy on liquid NIFTY option contracts and structure it so it can bolt onto a typical Indian brokerage API (for example Zerodha Kite Connect or similar). Use any robust language—Python is preferred for its back-testing libraries—but I am open to alternatives if they offer an edge. opportunities.title: Intraday Gold Futures Trading Bot
opportunities.description: I need a fully-automated bot that trades gold futures contracts intraday and does so based on a strategy you have already developed and refined. The system must open and close all positions within the same trading day, reacting quickly to market shifts and executing with minimal latency. Please integrate the bot with a widely used futures brokerage gateway or API (NinjaTrader, Interactive Brokers, CQG, or a similar alternative you are comfortable with). I will run it on a VPS, so stable, headless deployment and clear installation instructions are essential. Deliverables • Source code with clean, well-commented logic for order generation, position sizing, risk limits, and real-time monitoring • A brief document showing historical back-test results on gold futures demonstrating profitability and the main performance metrics (win rate, max drawdown, average trade duration) • Setup guide so I can replicate your environment and go live without guesswork Acceptance criteria • Trades only gold futures (no spot, ETFs, or options) • Flat by the end of every session • Passes a forward test of at least two trading days on my side without errors or disconnections Once everything is delivered and validated, I will take it from there for live execution.

opportunities.title: Magazine Production & Digital Operations VA
opportunities.description: # Magazine Production & Digital Operations VA | WordPress, Facebook & AI **Remote | 10–15 hours per week initially | Potential 40 hours per week from January 2027** ### About the Opportunity We're launching **Around Ashford**, a brand-new UK local publishing and digital media business, on **1st December 2026**. Our business includes six bi-monthly local magazines, an online business directory, community events, local advertising and plans for national franchise expansion. Our website is almost ready, and we're looking for an exceptional VA to join us before launch, learn our systems and help us grow. **This is a long-term opportunity, not a collection of occasional freelance tasks.** ### Your Responsibilities **Magazine Production** - Produce professional magazine layouts ready for commercial printing. - Prepare print-ready PDFs, including CMYK, bleed, crop marks and correct resolution. - Manage advertising artwork, production deadlines and printer communication. - Coordinate production across six magazine editions. **Facebook Marketing** - Create compelling, scroll-stopping Facebook posts. - Design graphics using Canva and AI. - Schedule regular posts to build awareness before and after launch. - Promote businesses, events and advertising opportunities. - Help grow our audience and generate enquiries. **Email Marketing** - Write engaging, persuasive emails. - Schedule campaigns using Brevo. - Manage contact tagging, segmentation and email lists. - Create automated follow-up sequences and newsletters. - Track enquiries and responses. **WordPress & Business Operations** - Learn and manage our new WordPress backend. - Maintain directory listings, events, jobs and advertiser accounts. - Manage customer enquiries, bookings and renewals. - Coordinate day-to-day administration and suppliers. - Find opportunities to improve efficiency using AI and automation. ### Communication Is Extremely Important You MUST speak excellent, fluent English and be confident speaking with UK customers and suppliers by telephone or Zoom. You must also have: - Professional-quality headset and microphone. - Excellent audio quality without background noise. - Fast, reliable and secure internet. - Backup internet and power arrangements. - Secure computer and quiet working environment. - Availability during agreed UK working hours. ### The Person We're Looking For Our founder is a fast-moving entrepreneur who values speed, initiative and results. **We want facts, not lengthy explanations.** When asked a question, give a clear, concise answer. We don't need a chapter explaining how you intend to complete a task. You should be: - Highly proactive and self-motivated. - Extremely organised and dependable. - Quick to learn new systems. - Confident making sensible decisions independently. - Comfortable using ChatGPT and AI daily. - Commercially aware and interested in business growth. - Able to work quickly without sacrificing quality. **Previous experience producing magazines for commercial printers is essential.** ### Hours & Growth **November 2026:** 10–15 hours weekly, learning our systems and preparing for launch. **1st December 2026:** Official launch. **January 2027 onwards:** Potential to increase towards 40 hours weekly as the business gains momentum. Facebook marketing will be central to generating awareness and attracting customers. The faster we grow our audience, acquire advertisers and generate revenue, the sooner we expect to increase working hours. We want someone who is motivated to help make that happen! ### How to Apply Please include: 1. Examples of magazines you have personally produced for commercial printing. 2. A 60–90 second video introducing yourself in English. 3. Your experience with WordPress, Facebook, Canva, Brevo and ChatGPT. 4. Details of your headset, internet connection and backup arrangements. 5. Your hourly rate and availability for UK working hours. **Applications without evidence of magazine production experience will not be considered.** We're looking for one outstanding person who wants to grow with our business and become a trusted, long-term member of our team.

Our website is almost ready, and we're looking for an exceptional VA to join us before launch, learn our systems and help us grow. **This is a long-term opportunity, not a collection of occasional freelance tasks.** ### Your Responsibilities **Magazine Production** - Produce professional magazine layouts ready for commercial printing. - Prepare print-ready PDFs, including CMYK, bleed, crop marks and correct resolution. - Manage advertising artwork, production deadlines and printer communication. - Coordinate production across six magazine editions. **Facebook Marketing** - Create compelling, scroll-stopping Facebook posts. - Design graphics using Canva and AI. - Schedule regular posts to build awareness before and after launch. - Promote businesses, events and advertising opportunities. - Help grow our audience and generate enquiries. **Email Marketing** - Write engaging, persuasive emails. - Schedule campaigns using Brevo. - Manage contact tagging, segmentation and email lists. - Create automated follow-up sequences and newsletters. - Track enquiries and responses. **WordPress & Business Operations** - Learn and manage our new WordPress backend. - Maintain directory listings, events, jobs and advertiser accounts. - Manage customer enquiries, bookings and renewals. - Coordinate day-to-day administration and suppliers. - Find opportunities to improve efficiency using AI and automation. ### Communication Is Extremely Important You MUST speak excellent, fluent English and be confident speaking with UK customers and suppliers by telephone or Zoom. You must also have: - Professional-quality headset and microphone. - Excellent audio quality without background noise. - Fast, reliable and secure internet. - Backup internet and power arrangements. - Secure computer and quiet working environment. - Availability during agreed UK working hours. ### The Person We're Looking For Our founder is a fast-moving entrepreneur who values speed, initiative and results. **We want facts, not lengthy explanations.** When asked a question, give a clear, concise answer. We don't need a chapter explaining how you intend to complete a task. You should be: - Highly proactive and self-motivated. - Extremely organised and dependable. - Quick to learn new systems. - Confident making sensible decisions independently. - Comfortable using ChatGPT and AI daily. - Commercially aware and interested in business growth. - Able to work quickly without sacrificing quality. **Previous experience producing magazines for commercial printers is essential.** ### Hours & Growth **November 2026:** 10–15 hours weekly, learning our systems and preparing for launch. **1st December 2026:** Official launch. **January 2027 onwards:** Potential to increase towards 40 hours weekly as the business gains momentum. Facebook marketing will be central to generating awareness and attracting customers. The faster we grow our audience, acquire advertisers and generate revenue, the sooner we expect to increase working hours. We want someone who is motivated to help make that happen! ### How to Apply Please include: 1. Examples of magazines you have personally produced for commercial printing. 2. A 60–90 second video introducing yourself in English. 3. Your experience with WordPress, Facebook, Canva, Brevo and ChatGPT. 4. Details of your headset, internet connection and backup arrangements. 5. Your hourly rate and availability for UK working hours. **Applications without evidence of magazine production experience will not be considered.** We're looking for one outstanding person who wants to grow with our business and become a trusted, long-term member of our team."

I’ll supply brand guidelines and service details; you bring the strategy, ad accounts management and ongoing optimisation. If you have proven experience generating service-industry leads in the Gulf region, show me recent results and outline your timeline for launch.

opportunities.title: Editor Dinámico de Videos Cortos
opportunities.description: Buscamos editor/a de vídeo para Reels y TikTok · Remoto · Media jornada Somos una agencia de marketing en España que produce contenido constante para Instagram y TikTok, y buscamos un/a editor/a especializado/a en vídeo corto con estilo dinámico para unirse a nuestro equipo de forma estable. Qué harás Recibirás el material grabado junto con el guion o las indicaciones de cada pieza. Montarás vídeos ágiles: cortes rápidos, motion graphics ligeros, zooms, transiciones fluidas y subtítulos que mantengan la atención hasta el último segundo. Adaptarás cada vídeo al formato vertical, cuidando resolución, color y ritmo musical. Entregarás los archivos finales listos para publicar (MP4/H.264) y, cuando haga falta, el proyecto editable en Premiere, Final Cut o DaVinci Resolve. Cómo trabajaremos 100% remoto, con dedicación de media jornada. Volumen regular de vídeos cada semana, con objetivos claros (duración, gancho inicial, retención). Pago mensual fijo en dólares. Revisiones periódicas para cuidar la calidad y los plazos. Lo que valoramos Experiencia editando Reels o TikToks con buenos resultados. Dominio de subtítulos, efectos de texto y sound design. Rapidez de respuesta y comunicación proactiva. Iniciativa para proponer mejoras cuando veas oportunidades. ¿Te interesa? Envíanos tu portafolio de vídeos cortos e indícanos cuántas piezas de este estilo podrías entregar por semana. Los perfiles seleccionados harán una pequeña prueba pagada ✨

Si consideras que mejorar la calidad del audio o separar ligeramente las pistas facilita distinguir las voces, eres libre de aplicar tus propias técnicas de edición o noise reduction antes de transcribir. Entregables esperados: • Archivo de texto editable (Word o Google Docs) con la transcripción completa. opportunities.title: Presentador TikTok Fútbol y NBA
opportunities.description: Quiero incorporar a un presentador capaz de llevar directos en TikTok centrados en análisis y debates sobre fútbol y NBA. Necesito a alguien que domine ambos deportes, lance datos y opiniones con soltura y, sobre todo, mantenga un tono energético y divertido que enganche a la audiencia desde el primer minuto. Responsabilidades clave • Planificar cada sesión en torno a la actualidad: resultados, estadísticas, historias de vestuario y comparativas entre ligas y jugadores. • Abrir y moderar el debate en tiempo real con los espectadores, fomentando la participación mediante preguntas, encuestas y retos. • Aprovechar las herramientas nativas de TikTok Live (duetos, filtros, comentarios fijados) para mantener un ritmo dinámico y visualmente atractivo. • Cerrar cada directo con un resumen claro y llamados a la acción que impulsen seguidores y engagement para la cuenta. Lo que valoro en tu propuesta • Experiencia previa presentando o comentando eventos deportivos en streaming, radio o podcast. • Conocimiento demostrable de fútbol europeo y NBA, incluidos jugadores, tácticas y estadísticas actuales. • Ejemplos de directos donde se aprecie tu estilo en pantalla y capacidad para mantener la energía. Si disfrutas conversando de deportes y sabes convertir datos en entretenimiento en vivo, quiero conocer tu experiencia y ver tu mejor clip en acción.

opportunities.title: Migración Completa A3CON a A3RP
opportunities.description: Quiero trasladar absolutamente toda la información que hoy tengo en A3CON — datos contables, históricos, documentos adjuntos, clientes y proveedores — a A3RP sin perder ni un detalle. Una vez importados los datos necesito que A3RP quede listo para trabajar con la misma estructura que utilizamos ahora: contabilidad al día, impuestos configurados y los modelos preparados para su presentación. Además de la migración y la configuración, requiero una breve sesión de explicación para mi equipo. La idea es que, al finalizar, cada usuario entienda dónde está cada cosa y pueda seguir con su operativa diaria sin interrupciones. Entrego acceso a ambos entornos y estaré disponible para resolver cualquier duda sobre nuestros flujos actuales o sobre la nomenclatura interna que manejamos. Espero una validación final conjunta para verificar que los saldos, los informes y los modelos coincidan con los datos originales antes de dar por cerrado el proyecto.
